metadata.authority: IAU constellation boundaries, defined by Delporte (1930) on the B1875.0 equinox. Machine-readable vertex catalogue: Davenhall & Leggett (1989), VizieR VI/49.
metadata.simplificationNote: Seed data stores each constellation's published J2000 RA/Dec extent as a closed rectangular region, not the full stepped IAU polygon. IAU boundaries run along arcs of constant RA and constant Dec, so an extent is a faithful but coarse subset of the real boundary. Run scripts/generate-constellation-boundaries.mjs while online to replace this seed with the full VI/49 vertex lists.
metadata.license: IAU boundary definitions are public domain.
metadata.attribution: IAU / Delporte 1930; machine-readable form Davenhall & Leggett 1989.
